title: Armistice ends the fighting of World War I
summary: Germany signed an armistice with the Allies in a railway carriage in the forest of Compiegne, and fighting on the Western Front stopped at 11 a.m.
reason: Germany's army was retreating, its allies had collapsed, and revolution had broken out at home.
significance: It ended World War I, in which about 20 million people died.
place: Glade of the Armistice, Compiegne, France
